test.transaction: six servos, one contiguous 15-byte feedback block per servo, one shared deadline per whole-arm read

decision: Keep the existing 20 ms value. It is more conservative than the isolated static formula candidate, and mixed read/write preflight operations previously produced read timeouts at 20 ms; reducing the configured budget would be unsupported.
scope_limit: This verifies unloaded torque-off static feedback reads only. Post-write register reads, command writes, active-motion feedback and cleanup semantics remain for CAL-052/053 and CAL-ISSUE-039.
